lines.en: label wakanadate25p1:
scene wakanaastrip1
As I sit behind a desk I feel myself spending less and less time with as life ticks on, I take a moment to understand and appreciate just how far I’ve come and what I’ve accomplished so far.
lines.zh: 我坐在一张随着日子过去、我待在它后面的时间越来越少的办公桌后面，花了一点时间去理解和感激自己已经走了多远、完成了什么。

lines.en: I’ve witnessed the end of days.
lines.zh: 我见证了末日。

lines.en: scene reset4
scene wakanaastrip1
I’ve learned my name and begun the process of accepting who I am.
lines.zh: 我得知了自己的名字，并开始接受自己是谁。

lines.en: scene memorylane25
scene wakanaastrip1
I’ve even fallen in love.
lines.zh: 我甚至坠入过爱河。

scene wakanaastrip1
And through it all, of course I’ve had my fair share of problems.
lines.zh: 而一路走来，当然我也没少遇到问题。

lines.en: In fact, there have been so many problems that it would take me a whole cycle just to recount them.
lines.zh: 事实上，问题多到光是把它们数一遍就得花掉我整整一个循环。

lines.en: But I’ve not been without support.
lines.zh: 但我并不是没有支撑。

lines.en: Throughout this entire journey, there’s been someone right beside me the whole time.
lines.zh: 在这整段旅程里，有一个东西一直陪在我身边。

lines.en: Someone who has kept me grounded, and knows me better than almost anyone.
lines.zh: 一个让我脚踏实地、比几乎任何人都要了解我的东西。

lines.en: That someone is this desk.
lines.zh: 那个东西就是这张桌子。

lines.en: : I love you, desk.
lines.zh: : 我爱你，桌子。

lines.en: : (Is a desk)
lines.zh: : （是一张桌子）

lines.en: Unfortunately, some things in life just aren’t fair. And the things we want to speak to the most completely ignore us.
lines.zh: 可惜，人生有些事就是不公平。而我们最想说话的对象，往往完全不理我们。

lines.en: But that’s okay. Because sometimes, other things or creatures show up to keep us company.
lines.zh: 但没关系。因为有时候，会有别的东西或别的生物出现来陪我们。

lines.en: : Come in.
lines.zh: : 进来。

lines.en: scene wakanaastrip2
: Did I just hear you...tell your desk that you love it?
lines.zh: : 我刚刚是不是听见你……跟你桌子说你爱它？

lines.en: And sometimes they call you out on things you’d really wish they didn’t hear and weren’t actually able to call you out on.
lines.zh: 而有时候，它们会揪出你真希望它们没听见、也真不该有能力揪出来的事。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 荒川。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Do you want to fuck your desk?
lines.zh: : 你想操你的桌子吗？

lines.en: : I don’t want to fuck my desk, Wakana. I was just recalling how long it’s been with me and how much we’ve been through together.
lines.zh: : 我不想操我的桌子，Wakana。我只是在回想它跟了我多久、我们一起经历过多少。

lines.en: : Oh my god. You want to fuck your desk.
lines.zh: : 我的天。你想操你的桌子。

lines.en: : Wakana, why are you here?
lines.zh: : Wakana，你来这儿干嘛？

lines.en: scene wakanaastrip3
: I came to ask if you’d like to accompany me out to the city if you didn’t have any plans tonight. But seeing as you do and they involve fucking your desk, I will just wait until tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 我是来问你今晚要是没安排，愿不愿意陪我进城。不过既然你有安排，而且安排里还包括操你的桌子，那我就等到明天吧。

lines.en: : You know, this is exactly why I never speak when no one’s around. Someone always shows up exactly when they’re not supposed to.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，这正是我从不在没人的时候说话的原因。总有人会在最不该出现的时候出现。

lines.en: : Yes, I apologize for interrupting your...confession. I will take my leave now.
lines.zh: : 是，我为打断你的……告白道歉。我现在就走。

lines.en: : Wait, no. You don’t have to go.
lines.zh: : 等等，别。你不用走。

lines.en: : I’m aware. I wasn’t actually planning on leaving. I just wanted to make it seem as if I was so you’d have less of a desire to fuck your desk and-
lines.zh: : 我知道。我本来也没打算走。我只是想让你以为我要走，好让你少一点操桌子的欲望，然后——

lines.en: : Wakana, why are you inviting me to the city? Are Osako and Imani busy?
lines.zh: : Wakana，你为什么请我进城？Osako 和 Imani 忙吗？

lines.en: scene wakanaastrip4
: No. I’d just rather go with you instead.
lines.zh: : 不忙。我只是更想跟你一起去。

lines.en: : Right. And what’s the catch, exactly?
lines.zh: : 行。那具体有什么条件？

lines.en: : Can the catch be that you don’t slam me up against another wall and act all tough? That wasn’t particularly enjoyable for me last time. I’m sure it’s a precious memory for you, though.
lines.zh: : 条件可以是「别再把我按在墙上装硬汉」吗？上次那体验对我不怎么好。不过我想对你来说大概是个珍贵的回忆。

lines.en: : I promise not to slam you up against anything. But I still don’t get why it has to be me instead of one of them.
lines.zh: : 我保证不会把你按在任何东西上。可我还是不明白为什么非得是我，而不是她们中的一个。

lines.en: : You really want to fuck that desk, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的很想操那张桌子，对吧？

lines.en: : I don’t want to fuck the desk, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 我不想操桌子，Wakana。

lines.en: : Arakawa, despite me not owing you an explanation for literally anything ever, I’m asking you to come with me because you are my friend and I value you as a person.
lines.zh: : 荒川，虽然我这辈子什么都不欠你解释，但我请你跟我来，是因为你是我的朋友，我重视你这个人。

lines.en: : Do you value me as a coworker as well?
lines.zh: : 你作为同事也重视我吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely fucking not. You should have been fired years ago.
lines.zh: : 他妈的完全不。你几年前就该被开除了。

lines.en: : This is going to be a really fun trip, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这趟出行会非常有意思，是吧？

lines.en: : We shall see when we arrive at our destination.
lines.zh: : 等我们到了目的地就知道了。

lines.en: : And that destination is?
lines.zh: : 那目的地是？

lines.en: scene black
: A secret. Now, come. Unless you need a moment to say goodbye to the desk.
lines.zh: : 秘密。走吧。除非你需要一点时间跟桌子道别。

lines.en: : Please don’t make this a thing.
lines.zh: : 请别把这当成一个梗。

lines.en: : It is far too late for that, I’m afraid.
lines.zh: : 恐怕现在说这个已经太迟了。

lines.en: Despite having thirty minutes left of my “counseling” session, I decide to leave early so Wakana can reap whatever benefits of our friendship she’s after today.
lines.zh: 尽管我的「心理咨询」时间还剩三十分钟，我还是决定提前离开，好让 Wakana 今天能从我们的友谊里捞到她想要的那些好处。

lines.en: Unfortunately for me, I highly doubt one of those benefits will be my penis. So I will remain blissfully ignorant for the next hour or so as she drags me to an unknown location to not have sex with me.
lines.zh: 可惜对我来说，那些好处里大概不会有我的阴茎。所以在接下来一个小时左右，她把我拖去某个不明地点、又不跟我上床的这段时间里，我会一直幸福地蒙在鼓里。

lines.en: scene noonsky
It becomes evident that by “the city,” Wakana literally meant the city as we get off the train at the first stop in the urban district.
lines.zh: 当我们在这片商业区的第一站下车时，事情就清楚了：Wakana 说的「城里」字面意思就是城里。

lines.en: With most people getting out of work around this time, navigating through the station becomes a chore.
lines.zh: 这个点大多数人刚下班，穿过车站成了件苦差事。

lines.en: But, as if she’s an expert when it comes to this exact pathway, Wakana quickly guides me to the nearest exit and the two of us make our way out into the street.
lines.zh: 但 Wakana 就像这条路线上的老手，迅速把我领到最近的出口，我俩一起走到了街上。

lines.en: It’s nice out today, but it’s also not.
lines.zh: 今天外面天气不错，但也不算。

lines.en: I like that I get to be here with her, but I also don’t.
lines.zh: 我喜欢能跟她在这儿，但也不喜欢。

lines.en: I’m conflicted in a number of ways and long for the one who has always been there for me.
lines.zh: 我在好几个方面都很矛盾，并且想念那个一直陪着我的东西。

lines.en: scene wakanaastrip5
My beautiful desk.
lines.zh: 我美丽的桌子。

lines.en: scene wakanaastrip6
Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: As it turns out, the “secret” place Wakana wanted to bring me was a third location of that same bookstore I’ve gone to with Futaba in the past.
lines.zh: 结果证明，Wakana 想带我去的那个「秘密」地方，是我以前跟 Futaba 一起去过的那家书店的第三家分店。

lines.en: You know, the one she tried to confess her feelings for me in.
lines.zh: 就是她试着对我表白的那家。

lines.en: Or the one we were kicked out of during the second Dorm Wars for...huh. Why were we kicked out again?
lines.zh: 或者是我们第二次宿舍大战时被赶出去的那家……嗯。我们到底为什么被赶出去来着？

lines.en: Either way, I’m here now with someone else. And today’s someone is not only significantly more well-versed in the world of literature, but a better writer as well. Probably.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我现在跟另一个人在这儿。而且今天这个人不仅在文学世界里明显更博学，大概也是个更好的作家。大概吧。

lines.en: Come to think of it, I haven’t read or heard any of Wakana’s poetry. But I’m sure it exists since she’s always going off the rails about the art form as a whole.
lines.zh: 想起来，我倒是从没读过或听过 Wakana 的诗。但我肯定它存在，因为她一谈起这门艺术就收不住。

lines.en: Come to think of something else, there’s not really much I know about Wakana to begin with.
lines.zh: 又想起来，我对 Wakana 本来就知道得不太多。

lines.en: But her wanting me here is all I really need to know right now.
lines.zh: 但她想让我在这儿，就是我现在唯一需要知道的事。

lines.en: Maybe we are the kind of friends who can just “hang out” without there needing to be some sort of ulterior motive or purpose for it.
lines.zh: 也许我们就是那种能单纯「一起玩」的朋友，不需要什么别的目的或用处。

lines.en: Maybe she’s believed that this whole time and I have been the weird one for expecting there to be more to it.
lines.zh: 也许她一直都是这么想的，反倒是一直期待「还有别的意思」的我才是那个怪人。

lines.en: And maybe today will be the day I do learn more about her.
lines.zh: 也许今天就是我真正开始了解她的日子。

lines.en: I think I’d like that.
lines.zh: 我想我会喜欢的。

lines.en: I think I’m lonely.
lines.zh: 我想我很孤独。

lines.en: : Have you figured out why we’re here yet, Arakawa?
lines.zh: : 你想出我们为什么在这儿了吗，荒川？

lines.en: : To hang out?
lines.zh: : 来玩？

lines.en: : Yes and no. We are “hanging out.” This much is true. But more than that, I need your help with something.
lines.zh: : 是也不是。我们是在「玩」。这没错。但不止如此，我需要你帮个忙。

lines.en: : Just “oh?” No snide remark or sexual innuendo in regard to what it is I need?
lines.zh: : 就「哦」？没有挖苦的话，也没有关于我需要什么的性暗示？

lines.en: : Not today.
lines.zh: : 今天没有。

lines.en: scene wakanaastrip7
: Is something the matter?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : No. Just tell me whatever it is you need help with.
lines.zh: : 没有。直接告诉我你要我帮什么。

lines.en: : Okay. But, in doing so, I’d like to invoke the “catch” you had me add earlier and ask that you do not sexually assault me after I tell you.
lines.zh: : 好。不过在那之前，我想动用你先前让我加上的那个「条件」，请你在我说了之后别对我进行性侵犯。

lines.en: : I’ll do my best.
lines.zh: : 我尽力。

lines.en: scene wakanaastrip8
: I’m conducting some independent research on a woman who may have been close to you. And by may, I mean you were reduced to a hulking manchild the last time I brought her up in a scenario like this.
lines.zh: : 我在独立调查一个可能跟你关系很近的女人。说「可能」，是因为上次我在类似场合提起她时，你就退化成了一个庞大的巨婴。

lines.en: : I don’t know what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : So The Girl Who Cannot Breathe rings no bells whatsoever?
lines.zh: : 那《无法呼吸的女孩》一点印象都没有？

lines.en: : Nothing at all? Not a peep?
lines.zh: : 一点都没有？一声不吭？

lines.en: scene wakanaastrip9
: Hah...

: Arakawa, listen...if it makes you feel any better, I’m not doing this for you. You’re an adult and it is well within your right to keep whatever secrets you’ve bottled up over the years to yourself.
lines.zh: : 荒川，听着……如果说出来能让你好受一点的话：我做这个不是为了你。你是成年人，你这些年来憋在心里的任何秘密，你完全有权守着。

lines.en: : Would I hear them out should you wish to unbottle them? Sure. But I will not force it out of you, nor belittle you for your reluctance in opening up to me.
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意把它们倒出来，我会听吗？当然。但我不会逼你说，也不会因为你对我打开心扉这件事有迟疑而贬低你。

lines.en: : Then why are you doing this?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么做这个？

lines.en: scene wakanaastrip10
: Because either your niece has a remarkable gift or she has plagiarized her work for my poetry contest and must be punished. Though, I am leaning toward the former given your background as well.
lines.zh: : 因为要么你的侄女有非凡的天赋，要么她为我的诗歌比赛抄袭了作品、必须受罚。不过考虑到你的背景，我倾向于前者。

lines.en: : Either way, I know you know something. And that even if you’ve given up on ever telling anyone anything about the way you’re feeling, you value your niece.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我知道你知道点什么。而且就算你已经放弃了把这些年的感受告诉任何人，你依然在乎你的侄女。

lines.en: : What good will getting involved do if she has a “gift?” It’s poetry. It’s not like she needs an athletic coach or anything like that. She can just write and that’ll be it.
lines.zh: : 如果她真有「天赋」，参与进去有什么用？那是诗。她又不需要什么运动教练之类的。她写就行了，就这样。

lines.en: : A gift is not always a good thing, Arakawa. A wrong message in the right hands can change the world for the worse.
lines.zh: : 天赋不总是好事，荒川。一个错误的信息落到对的人手里，能把世界变得更糟。

lines.en: : And you think you can swoop in and prevent that from happening by...what? Finding more work from a writer you supposedly know all about already?
lines.zh: : 而你觉得你能冲进来阻止那件事发生……靠什么？靠去找一个你声称已经了如指掌的作家的更多作品？

lines.en: scene wakanaastrip11
: There would be no need for research if I already knew everything, Arakawa. But the hint that I was given at the beach was enough to prompt this investigation.
lines.zh: : 要是我什么都知道，就用不着做研究了吧，荒川。但在海滩上得到的那条线索，足够让我展开这次调查了。

lines.en: : It could be anything. A second pen name. The title of an anthology more of her work was published in. It’s like I’m trying to put together a puzzle right now and I only have half of the pieces.
lines.zh: : 什么都可能是。第二个笔名。收录了她更多作品的某本选集的书名。我现在就像在拼一幅拼图，而手上只有一半的碎片。

lines.en: : If you know something, help me. Because if your niece did write that poem, it could mean she’s following in the footsteps of someone who got lost in the dark long before you and I did.
lines.zh: : 如果你知道什么，帮我。因为如果你的侄女真的写了那首诗，那可能意味着她正在追随一个远在你我之前就迷失在黑暗里的人的脚步。

lines.en: : You’re her guardian, are you not? Isn’t it your responsibility to make sure she stays on the right path? Because she’s veering off, Arakawa. We are teachers. We must help her.
lines.zh: : 你是她的监护人，不是吗？确保她走在正确的路上，不就是你的责任？她正在偏离，荒川。我们是老师。我们必须帮她。

lines.en: : It’s just a poem, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 只是一首诗而已，Wakana。

lines.en: scene mm1
scene mm2
scene mm3
scene mm4
scene mm5
scene wakanaastrip12
: You know damn well that nothing is “just a poem,” Arakawa! I don’t understand why you keep saying that!
lines.zh: : 你他妈清楚得很，没有什么「只是一首诗」，荒川！我不明白你为什么老这么说！

lines.en: : You said just the other day that “The Road Not Taken” is just a poem. Are you changing your mind already?
lines.zh: : 你前两天还说《未选择的路》「只是一首诗」。你这么快就改主意了？

lines.en: : That was me being biased and pretentious! So if it gets you to open your fucking eyes, yes. I am changing my mind.
lines.zh: : 那是我带着偏见在装腔作势！所以如果这能让你他妈的睁开眼，对，我改主意了。

lines.en: : Your niece is mimicking the writing style of one of the most talented, yet utterly sickening artists to ever find their way onto my shelf.
lines.zh: : 你的侄女在模仿曾出现在我书架上、最有才华却也最令人作呕的那个艺术家的文风。

lines.en: : And yes, her work was emotionally evocative and brimming with a level of creativity few others have ever been able to match. But what she preached was madness.
lines.zh: : 是，她的作品情感充沛、创造力满溢到几乎无人能及。但她宣讲的东西是疯狂。

lines.en: : You have a responsibility. As a teacher. As a parent. As whatever the fuck you want to call yourself. And if you want to mope on your own time, have at it!
lines.zh: : 你有责任。作为老师。作为家长。作为你他妈想叫自己什么的什么。你要想在自己的时间里自怨自艾，随你！

lines.en: scene wakanaastrip13
: But right now, there is a girl who is on the brink of walking down a very dark path. And she needs our help.
lines.zh: : 但现在，有一个女孩正站在一条非常黑暗的路的入口。而她需要我们的帮助。

lines.en: : You got all of that from one poem?
lines.zh: : 你就从一首诗里得出所有这些？

lines.en: : Arakawa...it wasn't one poem.
lines.zh: : 荒川……那不是一首诗。

lines.en: : She submitted twenty of them.
lines.zh: : 她投了二十首。

lines.en: : And all of them could have won the competition.
lines.zh: : 而每一首都足以赢下比赛。

lines.en: : So either she really is mass plagiarizing, or there is something going on in her head that you need to be worried about. Because if her mother is who I think she is-
lines.zh: : 所以要么她真的在大规模抄袭，要么她脑子里正发生着什么你需要担心的事。因为如果她母亲是我认为的那个人——

lines.en: : Thank you for your concern.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的关心。

lines.en: scene wakanaastrip14
: I don’t know anything and Ami will be fine.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不知道，Ami 不会有事的。

lines.en: : There’s that look again...The same one you gave me last time. And the same one you probably would have given me if you didn’t just walk away on the beach.
lines.zh: : 又是那个表情……上次你给我的那个。如果那次在海滩上你没有直接走掉，你大概也会给我这个表情。

lines.en: : Just how much do you know about all of this?
lines.zh: : 这一切你到底知道多少？

lines.en: : I told you. I don’t know anything.
lines.zh: : 我说过了。我什么都不知道。

lines.en: : But you’re lying, Arakawa. You do.
lines.zh: : 可你在撒谎，荒川。你知道。

lines.en: : Even if that’s true, I wouldn’t have to tell you about it. And you should be minding your own business when it comes to my niece. There’s no need for you to get involved over a contest.
lines.zh: : 就算那是真的，我也没义务告诉你。而且在我侄女这件事上，你该管好你自己的事。为一个比赛没必要把你卷进来。

lines.en: : Why did you stop writing?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么不写了？……

lines.en: : What are you to her?...
lines.zh: : 你对她来说是什么？……

lines.en: scene black
: Nothing anymore.
lines.zh: : 什么都不是了。

lines.en: I step outside while Wakana finishes conducting whatever “research” she needs to do in the bookstore.
lines.zh: Wakana 在书店里继续做她那套「研究」的时候，我走到了门外。

lines.en: Frankly, I don’t really care.
lines.zh: 坦白说，我其实不在乎。

lines.en: And I was foolish for ever hoping that I wouldn’t be needed for something today.
lines.zh: 而我今天居然还傻乎乎地盼着不会被需要去做什么事。

lines.en: $ wakanadate25p1 = True
$ wakana_love += 1
